entries.query_str: how late can i ship usps priority mail from virginia to dublin ireland and still have it arrive before christmas
entries.answer:
For international Priority Mail to Ireland, USPS usually recommends shipping by **about December 9–10** to have a reasonable chance of arrival before December 25 [1]. Priority Mail International is quoted at 6–10 business days, but December customs backlogs in Ireland often add a few days [2].

If you're shipping now (Dec 16), your realistic options are:
- **Priority Mail Express International**: 3–5 business days quoted; the recommended holiday cutoff is typically around Dec 16–17, so today is borderline [1].
- **A private carrier (DHL/FedEx/UPS) express service**: more expensive, but 2–3 business days door to door is common [3].

Also note that gifts to Ireland over €45 in value can be charged VAT and handling on arrival, which the recipient pays [2].
